subject: Founders Lab — Bootcamp support & qualification criteria
messages:
From: Ada Zhou <ada@founderslab.co>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: Founders Lab Partnerships <partnerships@founderslab.co>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Bootcamp cohort support + qualification checklist

Hi Olga —

Hope you’re well. We’re finalizing the curriculum for our September founders bootcamp and would love to include Redwood as a platform partner. In past cohorts we’ve offered cloud credits and short trials to teams doing LLM or embeddings work — that’s a major draw for applicants.

Quick ask: can you share the qualification criteria and any standard support package (credit amounts, trial length, verification steps)? Also attached is the program application and a short one-pager about the bootcamp. We’re aiming to announce partners by July 6.

A few specifics we care about:
- Are credits available to companies incorporated within the last 36 months?
- Do you require an MOU or SOW before allocating credits?
- Is there an expedited review path for 10 founder teams that demonstrate production intent (demo + traction)?

If it helps, we can run a short joint FAQ page and list Redwood as a sponsor on the cohort page. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call next week.

Thanks —
Ada Zhou
Head of Partnerships, Founders Lab
ada@founderslab.co
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: FoundersLab_Bootcamp_2027_app.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Ada Zhou <ada@founderslab.co>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Bootcamp cohort support + qualification checklist

Hi Ada —

Thanks for the details and the application. Love the cohort focus. Quick summary of what we can offer and what we’ll need from your side:

What Redwood can offer (standard program):
- Up to $10,000 in platform credits per team for accepted startups (valid for 90 days).
- 30-day trial extension option for startups who can demonstrate production traffic or a signed pilot.
- One technical office hours slot per cohort for integration help.

Qualification & process:
1) Form: startups complete the short intake (we can re-use your PDF app) and we verify incorporation + basic identity.
2) Technical check: short questionnaire + 15-min demo for teams requesting the trial extension.
3) Legal: standard partner MOU (attached draft) — no procurement redlines expected for credits under $15k.
4) Approval timeline: 3–5 business days after complete intake and demo.

Notes / exceptions: we can make a cohort-wide allocation (a single pooled budget) instead of per-team if you prefer — that’s easier for administrative checks but less flexible per team. For teams with enterprise-sensitive data, we can route them to Redwood Dedicated or discuss Private deployment options.

I’m copying Marissa (programs) and Karthik (partnerships) — they can help with logistics and SOW wording. 

Would you be available Tuesday 30th at 10am PT for a 20-min sync? If yes, we’ll prepare the MOU + draft SOW to speed approvals.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai

Attachment: SOW_bootcamp-draft.docx (Word, 28 KB)

From: Ada Zhou <ada@founderslab.co>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: Founders Lab Partnerships <partnerships@founderslab.co>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Bootcamp cohort support + qualification checklist

Thanks Olga —

Tuesday 30th at 10am PT works for us. We prefer a pooled allocation model if that simplifies admin; happy to review the MOU and SOW ahead of the call.

One more ask — a small number of our teams (6–8) are asking for an extended trial window (additional 60 days) because they have embargoed demo timelines with investors. Is there a precedent for a longer extension for teams with investor commitments? If needed, we can provide an investor intro email or milestone confirmation.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Ada

Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Bootcamp cohort support + qualification checklist

Ada —

Thanks for confirming. For the extended 60-day trial for a small subset of teams we’ll need one of the following:
- A demo + brief investor commitment note (email or term-sheet redacted OK), or
- Evidence of at least one pilot/paid contract OR a signed mutual action plan that includes a go-to-production milestone within 90 days.

Operationally:
- We’ll provision the pooled $75k budget for this cohort and ask Founders Lab to nominate teams (list of team names + lead contact + incorporation country) by the cohort cut-off (Aug 15).
- Each nominated startup will submit the short intake; those requesting the 60-day extension will be triaged and fast-tracked (target 48-hour turnaround after demo).
- Legal: we’ll sign the standard MOU and an internal uplift addendum for extended trials (no additional fees from Redwood).

Marissa / Karthik: please flag any SOW language changes or billing flows that would block a pooled allocation. I want us ready to sign and announce next week if Founders Lab confirms.

Olga
Head of Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai
